adjudication_records.issue_text: quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/cli/command/AbstractUpdatesCommand.java:84 — printFeatureDisabled() hardcodes the literal 'rolling-updates' instead of Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey(), so the error message can silently drift out of sync if the feature's enum-derived key ever changes.

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, AbstractUpdatesCommand.printFeatureDisabled() hardcodes the feature key as the literal string 'rolling-updates' ("Unable to use this command. The preview feature 'rolling-updates' is not enabled.") rather than deriving it from Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey(). This is not a functional defect today, but it is a real maintainability/correctness-risk: if the enum-derived key ever changes, the message (and tests asserting it) could become inconsistent with the actual feature key.
